This release adds a reproducible offline demonstration of local indexing, cross-cut subtitle search and source-audio evidence export. No API credentials are needed.

## Downloads

- [Watch the 22-second walkthrough](https://github.com/xum66183-art/movie-commentary-workflow/releases/download/v0.3.0/demo.mp4).
- `movie-commentary-workflow-v0.3.0-demo.zip`: original synthetic inputs, actual exported evidence, preview, runtime versions, sanitized CLI receipts and internal checksums.
- `movie_commentary_workflow-0.3.0.tar.gz`: complete source distribution, including hidden skills, scripts, schemas, templates and tests. Keep the complete extracted directory; no standalone wheel is provided.
- `SHA256SUMS`: checksums for the attached source, demo bundle, video and preview.

![Offline demo preview](https://github.com/xum66183-art/movie-commentary-workflow/releases/download/v0.3.0/preview.png)

## Changes

- Add a single-command synthetic demo with 13 observable self-checks.
- Validate the source archive by unpacking it and running the tools and skill installer.
- Fix installed index skills mistaking the user's home directory for the public checkout.
- Add Chinese and English documentation, explicit upstream attribution, structured issue forms and a maintenance roadmap.

## Verification

[Clean GitHub CI](https://github.com/xum66183-art/movie-commentary-workflow/actions/runs/39586554812) passed on Python 3.11 and 3.12: **42 tests per environment**, Ruff, repository safety, skill and project validation, offline demo and source build. The manual release workflow repeats these checks against the selected source commit before generating and uploading attachments.

Release source: `482d2014457ce110bb5e69f8e08e03e652946e01`, merged from [PR #1](https://github.com/xum66183-art/movie-commentary-workflow/pull/1). Its source tree is identical to the tested PR commit `57b5b85`.

The demo contains generated geometric footage, a synthetic tone and Chinese captions. It does not call paid providers or demonstrate visual inference, script writing, cloned narration, real-film retrieval quality or a finished commentary. Provider request tests use simulations. Structural verification leaves production at `PROJECT_CREATED` with no index lock.

This is an independent Apache-2.0 extension of [straighttttt/movie-commentary-workflow](https://github.com/straighttttt/movie-commentary-workflow). The eight-skill framework, schemas and core templates retain upstream attribution; see [provenance](https://github.com/xum66183-art/movie-commentary-workflow/blob/v0.3.0/docs/provenance.md).

本版补齐可复现离线演示、完整源码包与中英文说明，修复安装后的项目路径判断。附件保留真实运行记录，不包含电影素材、私有项目或密钥。
